name: @embedpdf/example-cloud-dashboard
description: The CloudPDF product demo: upload documents, share them as different people with different scopes, open them in the cloud viewer, and watch every wire call in the inspector. No wasm in the bundle — rendering happens on the server.

scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @embedpdf/engine-core build && pnpm --filter @embedpdf/engine-services build && pnpm --filter @cloudpdf/contract build && pnpm --filter @cloudpdf/admin build && pnpm --filter @cloudpdf/engine build && pnpm --filter @cloudpdf/server build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:deps && concurrently -k -n api,ui "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:ui"
